system.description: Increase SP maximum by 1. Gain +5 Strength, lose 5 Willpower.

Those born under the sign of the Mage gain the Power Well (10) trait.

The character increases their maximum Magicka Points by 10.

Gain all three powers permanently (Blessed Touch, Blessed Word, Mara's Gift), but lose 5 Luck.

Grants Mara's Gift; acquire this power or trait through the birthsign selector.

Grants Blessed Touch; acquire this power or trait through the birthsign selector.

Grants Blessed Word; acquire this power or trait through the birthsign selector.
Those born under the sign of the Lady gain +5 Personality.
Those born under the sign of the Thief roll an extra lucky number that they never lose regardless of their Luck score.
Those born under the sign of the Warrior increase their SP maximum by 1.

Extra permanent lucky number. Replace Luck score with 50. Gain Akaviri Danger-Sense and Running Out of Luck.

Grants Akaviri Danger-Sense; acquire this power or trait through the birthsign selector.

Grants Running Out of Luck; acquire this power or trait through the birthsign selector.

The birthsign selector replaces rolled Luck with 50. This sign is available only after naturally rolling The Thief and cannot be selected by spending Luck.

Those born under the sign of the Tower gain the Treasure Seeker power and +5 Perception.

Grants Treasure Seeker; acquire this power or trait through the birthsign selector.

Those born under the Star-Cursed Apprentice have especially deep but volatile magicka reserves.

The character increases their maximum Magicka Points by 50.

This character takes 3 additional incoming magic damage and gains -30 penalty to resist non-damaging magic effects.

Increase Speed by 2. Gain +5 Agility.

Choose one: willpower or perception; apply -5. The birthsign selector records this choice as a separate penalty trait.

Gain +5 Agility and +5 Personality.

Choose one: willpower or strength; apply -5. The birthsign selector records this choice as a separate penalty trait.
Gain +5 Personality, +5 Endurance, and lose 5 Strength.
Those born under the sign of the Steed increase Speed by 2.

Those born under the sign of the Atronach are natural sorcerers with deep reserves of magicka, but they cannot generate magicka of their own.

The character increases their maximum Magicka Points by 50.

Roll a d10 when affected by magic from another source. On 5 or less, absorb the magic and recover missing MP up to its cost.

Grants Stunted Magicka; acquire this power or trait through the birthsign selector.

Gain Treasure Seeker power, +5 Perception, and +5 Agility.

Grants Treasure Seeker; acquire this power or trait through the birthsign selector.

Choose one: willpower or strength; apply -5. The birthsign selector records this choice as a separate penalty trait.
Those born under the sign of the Lord double their natural healing rate.

Double natural healing rate. Gain +5 Endurance.

This character takes 2 additional incoming fire damage and gains -20 penalty to resist non-damaging fire effects.

Gain Moonshadow power and +5 Perception.

Grants Moonshadow; acquire this power or trait through the birthsign selector.

Choose one: personality or strength; apply -5. The birthsign selector records this choice as a separate penalty trait.

Those born under the Star-Cursed Atronach gain deeper magicka reserves but suffer an attribute penalty.

The character increases their maximum Magicka Points by 75.

Roll a d10 when affected by magic from another source. On 5 or less, absorb the magic and recover missing MP up to its cost.

Grants Stunted Magicka; acquire this power or trait through the birthsign selector.

Choose one: agility or endurance; apply -5. The birthsign selector records this choice as a separate penalty trait.

Those born under the sign of the Shadow gain the Moonshadow power.

Grants Moonshadow; acquire this power or trait through the birthsign selector.
Choose one of the following powers at the beginning of each day: Blessed Touch, Blessed Word, or Mara's Gift. This power lasts until your next long rest, when you may choose again.

Those born under the sign of the Apprentice have a special affinity for magick of all kinds.

The character increases their maximum Magicka Points by 25.

This character takes 2 additional incoming magic damage and gains -20 penalty to resist non-damaging magic effects.

Those born under the Star-Cursed Mage gain Power Well (25) but suffer an attribute penalty.

The character increases their maximum Magicka Points by 25.

Choose one: perception or strength or personality; apply -5. The birthsign selector records this choice as a separate penalty trait.
Those born under the sign of the Lover gain +5 Agility.
